description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Addresses WEAK signal quality: temporal_stability shows only 3 distinct scores across all inputs (range 40-90), meaning it fails to discriminate between MCPs. The temporal_stability_signal_auditor.py was built 2026-04-21 but a dedicated enrichment is needed. Must read MULTIPLE metadata fields (registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars) to produce differentiated scores. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Must complete each call in under 2 seconds.
